name: Gemini in Chrome (Chrome built-in "Actor" / Glic, auto browse)
notes: Not an extension: browser-process ActorKeyedService/ExecutionEngine/ToolController drives renderer tools (chrome/renderer/actor/*) that synthesize WebMouseEvent/WebKeyboardEvent via widget->HandleInputEvent (same entry point as real input -> isTrusted:true; pressure not measured). inputPath set to "unknown" because the schema has no renderer-synthesized option. Nothing page-visible: no extension id, no WAR, no content script, no debugger infobar, no header, no global, no DOM insertion; glow/overlay/handoff button are browser UI (actor_border_view_controller, actor_overlay_ui). Detect only behaviourally: constant keydown->keyup / inter-key durations (kGlicActorKeyDownDuration / kGlicActorKeyUpDuration, defaults unknown), occluded-target path element.SimulateAccessibilityClick() = click without pointerdown, paste fallback (single insertFromPaste), regular cadence from observation_delay_controller page-stability waits. Navigation: PAGE_TRANSITION_AUTO_TOPLEVEL, browser-initiated (hypothesis: Sec-Fetch-Site none, no Referer). Local feature names: GlicActor, GlicActorUi (study GlicActorRolloutControl), component ActorSafetyLists 9.8200.9609; disable with --disable-features=GlicActor,GlicActorUi. No site-level opt-out in site_policy.cc.

name: Playwright Extension (Playwright MCP Bridge)
notes: Manifest has NO content_scripts, NO web_accessible_resources, NO externally_connectable -> nothing to probe by URL, no DOM injection. Pure chrome.debugger relay (attach/detach/sendCommand, tabs.create/remove); all CDP (Runtime.enable per frame, init scripts, utility worlds) comes unfiltered from the @playwright/mcp --extension client. Detect via infobar burst ("Playwright Extension" started debugging this browser) and robotic trusted input (single mouse move unless steps set). Tab group "Playwright · <clientName>", green ✓ badge "Connected to Playwright client" (not page-visible). navigator.webdriver stays false (real profile). Playwright utility-world bindings (__playwright__binding__, __pwInitScripts) are described as not page-visible. Env PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXTENSION_TOKEN skips approval.
